bookingId.description: Reuse this booking rather than minting a new one. Sent when a clerk re-picks a session for a draft that already holds a bookingReference: because a reservation's hearing_id is its bookingId, the booking pipeline releases the previous pick's rows before taking the new ones, so the abandoned session's capacity is restored in the same transaction. Absent on a first pick, in which case an id is minted and returned.

duration.description: Hearing duration in minutes. Required for duration-based sessions, where the reservation decrements available_duration by this amount.
